body: Coordinator lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-08). A send result of durableButNotWoken means only that the sender got no wake confirmation. It does NOT prove the recipient was not woken. On 2026-11-08 a relay message to the Windows B runner, session-9, came back durableButNotWoken, yet the runner received it, ran Greg's toolchain check and answered. I wrongly recorded it on w-a8af as proof of the remote-dispatch gap, and routed a duplicate job through Opus2. Before treating a not-woken send as failed: wait briefly for a reply, or check the recipient's read cursor (termal_read_mailbox_message for that message). Don't duplicate the work, and don't record it as a defect until the absence of action is shown.
